summary.name: ChatHelp.ai
summary.one_liner: ChatHelp.ai is an AI assistant platform for business, work, and study that offers a free website chat widget trained on your own content, plus a set of curated AI tools and agents.
use_cases: Add an AI support chatbot to a website
Answer visitor questions using your own documents and PDFs
Build a searchable internal knowledge base for staff
Write and auto-post blog articles to WordPress
Summarize Yelp reviews into actionable issues
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a website chat widget that can be trained on a business's own website content, support documents, PDFs, and product descriptions, and added with a single line of code. The widget can take over live conversations, collect leads through custom capture messages, and respond in 175+ languages. It can also connect to WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, Discord, and Line. A knowledge base feature lets users create private or public AI chat access links with source references. Additional curated tools include an AI writer with WordPress auto-posting, an image generator using Flux.1, and a Yelp review analyzer. The platform says it uses bring-your-own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini models.
notable: Free website chat widget added with one line of code
Bring your own AI API keys (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini)
Trained on your own documents, PDFs and website content with source references
Curated AI tools for SMB, office work and study, including WordPress auto-poster
caveats: Page does not state specific paid plan prices; pricing details are unknown beyond a free offer
Says 100+ tools are 'planned', not all currently available
Business files are said to be hosted on encrypted cloud; data handling details are marketing claims
